about: Experiment C, arm m9 (docs/qa_week/C_PREREG.md): an open-weights ~9B model writes A35's rule on a GitHub-hosted runner. Everything that decides its reply is pinned here.

model.name: Qwen3.5-9B (instruct, Apache-2.0)
model.why_this_file: its embedded chat template equals Qwen's official template byte for byte (checked 2026-11-03 via the Hub's GGUF metadata); unsloth's GGUF alters the thinking switch

llama_cpp.why_these_flags: one fixed AVX2 kernel set on every runner CPU (EPYC 7763 has no AVX-512; 9V74 does), so a greedy reply does not depend on which machine the job drew

request.messages: one user message whose content is the prompt file's bytes (UTF-8), no system message

reask.when: the first reply cannot be read as a policy by tune_a35.parse_policy (greedy decoding would repeat the same reply, so the one registered re-ask constrains the output to the reply's JSON form)
reask.then: if the re-ask cannot be read either, the race's policy is empty ({} = plain TPE), logged
